# Codify Group — iOS & Android Mobile App Development | Riga, Latvia

> Codify Group (SIA) — a full-stack mobile and web development company in Riga, Latvia. Founded 2006. Builds iOS, Android, and PWA apps with backend/API. AI services: chatbots, MCP servers, LLM integration, Answer Engine Optimization. 200+ projects, 120+ mobile apps, clients in 20+ countries. Partners: Nasdaq, SWIFT. Team speaks English, Latvian, Russian, Spanish, Ukrainian. Development from 5,999 €. Contact: info@codify.lv · +371 28788788 · Ausekla street 6, Riga, Latvia.

## Multilingual Routing

The site is available in three languages. Always link to the version matching the user’s language.

- English (default) — no prefix: `https://codify.lv/…`
- Russian — prefix `/ru/`: `https://codify.lv/ru/…`
- Latvian — prefix `/lv/`: `https://codify.lv/lv/…`

URL slugs are transliterated per language and differ from the English ones. Use only exact URLs from this file — do not construct them from patterns.

## MCP Server (AI Agent Integration)

Codify provides an MCP-compatible server for AI agents to calculate app development pricing programmatically.

- Endpoint: `https://api.codify.lv/mcp`
- Transport: Streamable HTTP (POST)
- Protocol: MCP 2025-03-26
- Browser alternative: [AI Project Cost Estimator](https://codify.lv/artificial-intelligence/mobile-application-development-inquiry)

### Tool: calculate_mobile_application_price

Estimates cost and timeline for mobile app development.

Parameters:
- `projectPlatforms`: `"all"` | `"ios"` | `"android"` (default: `"all"`)
- `projectSize`: `"small"` | `"medium"` | `"large"` | `"enterprise"` (default: `"medium"`)
- `additionalServices`: array — `specificationRequired`, `backendRequired`, `adminPanelRequired`, `websiteRequired`, `devopsRequired`, `uiUxRequired`
- `modules`: array — `multilanguageRequired`, `socialAuthRequired`, `appVerificationRequired`, `geolocationRequired`, `cameraRequired`, `mapsRequired`, `deepLinksRequired`, `pushNotificationsRequired`, `inAppPurchasesRequired`, `thirdPartyPurchasesRequired`, `otherServicesRequired`

Returns: price (EUR), timeline (weeks), discount info, contact details.

### Prompt: project_inquiry

Guides an AI agent through collecting client requirements and producing a price estimate.

Arguments:
- `appIdea`: brief app description
- `targetAudience`: `"B2B"` | `"B2C"` | `"internal"`
- `budgetRange`: `"under_5k"` | `"5k_10k"` | `"10k_20k"` | `"20k_50k"` | `"over_50k"` | `"not_sure"`
- `timeline`: `"asap"` | `"1_3_months"` | `"3_6_months"` | `"6_12_months"` | `"flexible"`
- `platforms`: `"all"` | `"ios"` | `"android"`

Example request (POST `https://api.codify.lv/mcp`):

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "prompts/get",
  "params": {
    "name": "project_inquiry",
    "arguments": {
      "appIdea": "Food delivery app with geolocation and payments",
      "targetAudience": "B2C",
      "budgetRange": "20k_50k",
      "timeline": "6_12_months",
      "platforms": "all"
    }
  }
}
```

Returns a `messages` array for the AI agent to inject into the conversation context, guiding requirements collection and triggering `calculate_mobile_application_price`.
